Projectile hits ship in Hormuz, injuring 11 Indians

A projectile struck the Indian-flagged vessel MT On Peace in the Hormuz Strait, injuring 11 Indian nationals. India has condemned the attack, which occurred near Oman. The specific nature of the projectile and the entity responsible have not been detailed in the coverage.
